ai_policy_backlash.why: Midterm wins for anti-AI candidates and data-center opposition put AI capex (the market's growth engine) in question; Nasdaq -5.5% and chips -12% on Nov 5 (TheStreet, JournalArta).

fed_hike_risk.why: CPI 3.7% and a strong +165k jobs print; CME shows ~72% odds of a December hike (Yahoo Finance).

quality_on_sale.why: Mega-cap forward P/Es compressed (GOOGL ~20x, NVDA ~15x) while cash flows are intact; selloff is policy/sentiment-led, not earnings-led so far.

fii_return.why: FIIs bought ~Rs15,000 cr on Nov 5, the biggest day in ~6 years, rotating out of AI-heavy markets (HDFC Sky).

already_rallied.why: Nifty +8.6% this week and up 7 sessions in a row; chasing after a straight-line rally has poor odds short term.

rbi_tightening.why: RBI hiked to 5.5% in Oct with CPI 5.54% and SBI Research expects 6% by December (Business Today).

trade_deal_unresolved.why: US-India deal still stuck on dairy/GM red lines (Goyal, Nov 3); exporters (textiles, gems, IT) carry tariff risk.

geopolitics.why: Mines hit tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Trump is weighing Iran strikes (TheStreet); gold is the hedge.

deep_reset.why: Gold is ~27% below its January record of $5,608 after the blow-off; much of the froth is out.

industrial_demand_risk.why: Silver is 57% off its January spike and still falling (-13% in a month); a slowdown in AI data-center and solar build-outs would hit industrial demand.

yields_rising.why: A December hike would lift T-bill yields; cash is paid ~4% while you wait to deploy.
